run_canned_robot_publisher: run the canned robot publisher to build a SparseVoxelMap from a ScanNet trajectory pickle and publish voxel data
build_sparse_voxel_map: build a SparseVoxelMap for a ScanNet scene using a SparseVoxelMapAgent model and a list of observations
publish_voxel_representation: publish a voxel representation to a directory using FilePublisher with a model and observations
load_trajectory_observations: load robot trajectory observations from a pickle file and move tensors to the target device
set_model_vocabulary: set the class ID to class name vocabulary on a SparseVoxelMapAgent using dataset metadata
